name: Necto
overview: Tools to keep your Jellyfin server reachable, secure and healthy.
description: Necto brings remote access, a WireGuard VPN, user management, scripts and storage monitoring into one plugin that runs entirely inside Jellyfin.

name: Zooid
overview: Keeps your whole collection of Jellyfin servers in sync with one another.
description: Zooid syncs content, history, metadata, people, users and playlists across Jellyfin servers, on a schedule and live between servers that both run it.
